**The four questions.** (1) A second call: the same server word heard twice reads the same (`ServerWord` is a pure reading; the machine's no-op for a repeated `sid` is Task 6's). (2) An empty input: a beat's 410 that named nothing ends nothing; an unreadable body is an answer with no reply. (3) After an interruption: not applicable — no state. (4) Another mode, orientation or language: both sources (beat and code) on every row of the shared vectors.

### Task 4: The pure rules — the stopped record, readiness, the beat's cadence and its body

Four rules the machine will apply, each pure and pinned before any transition uses it:

- **The stopped record (A17):** its shape, `keepUntil`, `DEFAULT_KEEP_MS` of 12 h, what delivers it, and what prunes it at startup.
- **Readiness (A11):** the four checks in the status line's order, the audio floor shared with JS by one vector file, and the no-accelerometer rule.
- **The cadence:** `pollSeconds` clamped to 5–300 s, at least every 10 s while a broadcast is held, and a 429's Retry-After within the same clamp.
- **The beat's body:** the amendment's fields, `stopped` only on a beat that holds no sid, `device` only on a claim, and `endReason` only on the final beat.

- Create: `K/core/StoppedRecord.kt`, `K/core/Readiness.kt`, `K/core/BeatCadence.kt`, `K/core/Beats.kt`

- Modify: `K/core/Heartbeat.kt` (`due` takes the interval; a 429 delays the next beat), `T/core/HeartbeatTest.kt`, `K/core/SessionMachine.kt` (`Heartbeats.tick` passes `Heartbeat.INTERVAL_MS`, so plan B's cadence is unchanged until Task 5)

```kotlin
package com.seazn.capture.engine.core

import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertFalse
import kotlin.test.assertNull
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class StoppedRecordTest {
  private val name = PairingName("fx-42", 1, "c980ff38")
  private val at = 1_790_000_000_000L

  @Test
  fun `A17 the record keeps the stopped sid until the broadcast's maximum duration has passed`() {
    // 300 minutes is 18 000 000 ms after the stop.
    val record = StoppedRecord.of(name, "sess_42", at, maxDurationMinutes = 300)
    assertEquals(StoppedRecord("fx-42", 1, "sess_42", at, at + 18_000_000), record)
  }

  @Test
  fun `RR2 a stop before the descriptor answered keeps it for twelve hours`() {
    // 12 h = 12 × 3 600 000 ms = 43 200 000 ms.
    assertEquals(43_200_000L, StoppedRecord.DEFAULT_KEEP_MS)
    assertEquals(at + 43_200_000, StoppedRecord.of(name, "sess_42", at, maxDurationMinutes = null).keepUntilEpochMs)
  }

  @Test
  fun `A17 a record is current until keepUntil, and startup prunes those past it`() {
    val record = StoppedRecord.of(name, "sess_42", at, maxDurationMinutes = 1)
    assertTrue(record.current(at + 59_999))
    assertFalse(record.current(at + 60_000))
    assertEquals(emptyList(), StoppedRecord.pruned(listOf(record), at + 60_000))
    assertEquals(listOf(record), StoppedRecord.pruned(listOf(record), at))
  }

  @Test
  fun `A17 a record is per code and slot, whatever issue of the code`() {
    val record = StoppedRecord.of(name, "sess_42", at, null)
    assertTrue(record.isFor(name.copy(tokenTag = "00000000")))
    assertFalse(record.isFor(name.copy(slot = 2)))
    assertFalse(record.isFor(name.copy(code = "fx-43")))
  }

  @Test
  fun `A17 delivered by a 2xx or a 410, and by replaced or taken, never by anything else`() {
    assertTrue(StoppedRecord.delivered(200, ServerWord.NoBroadcast))
    assertTrue(StoppedRecord.delivered(410, ServerWord.Over("sess_42", null)))
    assertTrue(StoppedRecord.delivered(200, ServerWord.Replaced))
    assertTrue(StoppedRecord.delivered(200, ServerWord.Taken))
    for (status in listOf(401, 404, 429, 500)) assertFalse(StoppedRecord.delivered(status, ServerWord.NoEvidence), "$status")
    assertFalse(StoppedRecord.delivered(null, ServerWord.NoEvidence))
  }
```

```kotlin
package com.seazn.capture.engine.core

/**
 * The operator's Stop wins (A17): the sid this phone stopped, kept in native app-private storage
 * until the server has heard the stop or the broadcast cannot still be open. It holds a sid, which
 * is no secret, and no token. One per code and slot: a newer Stop on the same pair replaces it.
 */
data class StoppedRecord(val code: String, val slot: Int, val sid: String, val stoppedAtEpochMs: Long, val keepUntilEpochMs: Long) {
  fun current(nowWallMs: Long): Boolean = nowWallMs < keepUntilEpochMs

  /** Per code and slot, whatever issue of the code: a re-issued code still names the same broadcasts. */
  fun isFor(name: PairingName): Boolean = code == name.code && slot == name.slot

  companion object {
    /**
     * RR2: a Stop before the descriptor answered has no `maxDurationMinutes`. Twelve hours is longer
     * than any match broadcast we expect, so the record cannot lapse while the broadcast might be
     * open, and short enough that a stale record ignores one dead sid for an afternoon at most.
     */
    const val DEFAULT_KEEP_MS = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1_000L

    fun of(name: PairingName, sid: String, nowWallMs: Long, maxDurationMinutes: Int?): StoppedRecord {
      val keepMs = maxDurationMinutes?.let { it * 60_000L } ?: DEFAULT_KEEP_MS
      return StoppedRecord(name.code, name.slot, sid, nowWallMs, nowWallMs + keepMs)
    }

    /** At startup: a record past `keepUntil` names a broadcast that cannot still be open. */
    fun pruned(records: List<StoppedRecord>, nowWallMs: Long): List<StoppedRecord> = records.filter { it.current(nowWallMs) }

    /**
     * Whether a beat that carried the record delivered it: a 2xx or a 410 (A17), and a `replaced` or
     * `taken` answer, which the server sends having read the beat (2026-10-01). A 404, 429, 5xx or
     * no answer keeps it.
     */
    fun delivered(status: Int?, word: ServerWord): Boolean =
      status != null && (status in 200..299 || status == 410 || word == ServerWord.Replaced || word == ServerWord.Taken)
  }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.seazn.capture.engine.core

/** Which way round the phone is held sideways (A11). [rotationDegrees] is the encoded rotation. */
enum class Side(override val wire: String, val rotationDegrees: Int) : Wire {
  /** The phone's top to the operator's left: `Surface.ROTATION_90`. */
  LEFT("left", 90),

  /** The phone's top to the operator's right: `Surface.ROTATION_270`. */
  RIGHT("right", 270),
}

/** How the accelerometer reads the phone, as the adapter's pose rule (Task 17) settled it. */
sealed interface Pose {
  data class Held(val side: Side) : Pose

  /** Flat, upright, in the dead band, or not yet settled: not ready. */
  data object NotHeld : Pose

  /** No accelerometer at all: never blocks (A11, JS's `watchPhysical` rule). */
  data object NoSensor : Pose
}

/**
 * The platform's readiness facts (A11). Native judges readiness for every start, held or remote:
 * one gate, one authority. The network is the machine's own fact (`Input.Network`), passed in.
 */
data class Readiness(val cameraFrames: Boolean, val audioPeak: Double, val pose: Pose) {
  /** At or above the floor; a NaN level compares false and reads silent. */
  val sound: Boolean
    get() = audioPeak >= AUDIO_FLOOR

  val held: Boolean
    get() = pose != Pose.NotHeld

  /** The side the broadcast encodes, read when Armed turns to Connecting: the side held, or LEFT with no sensor. */
  val side: Side
    get() = (pose as? Pose.Held)?.side ?: Side.LEFT

  /** The first check that fails, in the status line's order (amendment §2), or null when ready. */
  fun notReady(camera: CameraState, networkValidated: Boolean): NotReady? =
    when {
      !cameraFrames || camera != CameraState.OWN -> NotReady.CAMERA
      !sound -> NotReady.SOUND
      !networkValidated -> NotReady.NETWORK
      !held -> NotReady.HELD
      else -> null
    }

  companion object {
    /** Shared with JS's meter notch through `modules/capture-engine/src/wire/audio-floor.json`. */
    const val AUDIO_FLOOR = 0.05

    /** Before the platform's first reading: nothing is ready. */
    val UNKNOWN = Readiness(cameraFrames = false, audioPeak = 0.0, pose = Pose.NotHeld)
  }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.seazn.capture.engine.core

/**
 * How often the pairing beats (amendment, _Contract shapes_ and _Beats while locked_). The server
 * drives `pollSeconds` (60 s until about 30 min before the start, 10 s after), clamped here.
 */
object BeatCadence {
  const val MIN_POLL_S = 5
  const val MAX_POLL_S = 300

  /** Ruling 5's console health: while a broadcast is held, never longer than this between beats. */
  const val HELD_MAX_MS = 10_000L

  /** Before the server's first 2xx says otherwise (CD38): a claim that failed is retried soon. */
  const val DEFAULT_POLL_S = 10

  fun clamp(pollSeconds: Int?): Int = (pollSeconds ?: DEFAULT_POLL_S).coerceIn(MIN_POLL_S, MAX_POLL_S)

  fun intervalMs(pollSeconds: Int, held: Boolean): Long {
    val pollMs = clamp(pollSeconds) * 1_000L
    return if (held) minOf(pollMs, HELD_MAX_MS) else pollMs
  }

  fun retryAfterMs(retryAfterS: Int): Long = clamp(retryAfterS) * 1_000L
}
```

```kotlin
package com.seazn.capture.engine.core

/** What one beat reports (amendment, _Contract shapes_). Built from the phase; carries no secret. */
data class BeatFacts(
  val code: String,
  val slot: Int,
  val phoneId: String,
  val claim: Claim?,
  /** `Build.MODEL`, sent with a claim only (2026-10-01). */
  val deviceModel: String?,
  val sid: String?,
  val atEpochMs: Long,
  val state: String,
  val cause: Cause?,
  val notReady: NotReady?,
  val startFailed: StartFailure?,
  /** A17: a stopped sid, only when [sid] is null (RR3). */
  val stopped: String?,
  val automatic: Boolean,
  val transport: Transport?,
  val bitrateKbps: Int?,
  val delivery: Delivery,
  val deliveredLagMs: Long?,
  val audioOk: Boolean,
  val batteryPercent: Int?,
  val charging: Boolean?,
  val drainPctPerHour: Double?,
  val thermalStatus: Int?,
  val dataUsedBytes: Long,
  val appVersion: String,
  /** A8: only on the final beat, with [state] `ended`. */
  val endReason: EndReason? = null,
)

/** The beat's and `POST start`'s bodies. The JSON writer is the core's own (`Json`). */
object Beats {
  fun payload(facts: BeatFacts): String {
    val fields =
      mutableListOf<Pair<String, Any?>>(
        "code" to facts.code,
        "slot" to facts.slot,
        "phone" to facts.phoneId,
        "claim" to facts.claim,
      )
    if (facts.claim != null && facts.deviceModel != null) fields += "device" to JsonObject(listOf("model" to facts.deviceModel))
    fields +=
      listOf(
        "sid" to facts.sid,
        "at" to IsoTime.utc(facts.atEpochMs),
        "state" to facts.state,
        "cause" to facts.cause,
        "notReady" to facts.notReady,
        "startFailed" to facts.startFailed,
        "stopped" to (if (facts.sid == null) facts.stopped else null),
        "mode" to (if (facts.automatic) "automatic" else "operator"),
        "transport" to facts.transport,
        "bitrateKbps" to facts.bitrateKbps,
        "delivery" to facts.delivery,
        "deliveredLagS" to facts.deliveredLagMs?.let { Decimal.tenths(it / 1_000.0) },
        "audioOk" to facts.audioOk,
        "battery" to
          JsonObject(
            listOf(
              "percent" to facts.batteryPercent,
              "charging" to facts.charging,
              "drainPctPerHour" to facts.drainPctPerHour?.let { Decimal.tenths(it) },
            )
          ),
        "thermal" to facts.thermalStatus,
        "dataUsedMB" to Decimal.tenths(facts.dataUsedBytes / 1_000_000.0),
        "appVersion" to facts.appVersion,
      )
    if (facts.endReason != null) fields += "endReason" to facts.endReason
    return Json.obj(fields)
  }

  /** `POST start {phone}` (web ask 9). */
  fun startBody(phoneId: String): String = Json.obj(listOf("phone" to phoneId))
}
```

In `Heartbeat.kt`, `HeartbeatState` replaces `nextDueAtMs` with `lastSentAtMonoMs: Long? = null` and `notBeforeMs: Long = 0`, and the two functions become:

```kotlin
  /** The id of the beat to send now, or null. [intervalMs] is the cadence now: it may shorten between beats. */
  fun due(state: HeartbeatState, nowMs: Long, wallMs: Long, intervalMs: Long): Pair<HeartbeatState, Int?> {
    var next = state
    if (next.inFlightId != null && nowMs - next.inFlightSinceMs >= TIMEOUT_MS) next = next.failed()
    val last = next.lastSentAtMonoMs
    val waiting = next.inFlightId != null || nowMs < next.notBeforeMs || (last != null && nowMs < last + intervalMs)
    if (waiting) return next to null
    val id = next.nextId
    return next.copy(inFlightId = id, inFlightSinceMs = nowMs, nextId = id + 1, lastSentAtMonoMs = nowMs, lastSentAtEpochMs = wallMs) to id
  }

  /** The answer to beat [id], or the state unchanged for any other. A 429 sets [HeartbeatState.notBeforeMs]. */
  fun answered(state: HeartbeatState, id: Int, response: HeartbeatResponse, nowMs: Long): Pair<HeartbeatState, Boolean> {
    if (state.inFlightId != id) return state to false
    val over = response is HeartbeatResponse.Answered && SessionOver.said(response.status, response.reply?.state)
    val delayed = (response as? HeartbeatResponse.Answered)?.retryAfterS?.let { nowMs + BeatCadence.retryAfterMs(it) }
    val answered = if (delayed != null) state.copy(notBeforeMs = delayed) else state
    return when {
      over -> answered.copy(inFlightId = null, lastResult = HeartbeatResult.SESSION_OVER) to true
      response is HeartbeatResponse.Answered && response.status in 200..299 ->
        answered.copy(inFlightId = null, lastResult = HeartbeatResult.OK, consecutiveFailures = 0) to false
      else -> answered.failed() to false
    }
  }
```

## Batch C0b — the core's paired machine (pure Kotlin, JVM-tested)

Rebuilds plan B's machine on Batch C0a's values: the phases Pairing, Paired and Arming; the pairing's beats; the answer table; the start and its failures; the operator's Stop with A8's final beat and A17's record; and the snapshot that says all of it. ### Task 5: The paired phases, the intents, the beats on the pairing, and the readiness gate

The skeleton the rest of C0b fills in. A `pair` asks for permissions, then holds the service and the wake lock, and beats from the pairing. A `go-live` heard in Paired moves to Arming, which fetches the code. An open session shape moves to Armed, and Armed connects on its own once native judges the phone ready (A11), with the side held as the encoded rotation. `Input.Arm` goes. Plan B's ends (organiser stop, hold expiry) still end in `Phase.Ended` here; Task 6 moves them back to Paired.

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes Tasks 2–4's values.
- Produces:
  - `data class PairingState(request, phone, claim, automatic, language, heartbeat, waiting, readiness, stopped, stoppedInFlight, refused, starts, refusal, startFailed, lastEnd, codeEndedPending, lastBeatLine)` with `name` and `token`;
  - `Phase.Pairing(pairing, ids, networkValidated)`, `Phase.Paired(pairing, ids, networkValidated)`, `Phase.Arming(pairing, sid, cause, ids, networkValidated, asks, notBeforeMs, notCurrent, retrying)`;
  - `Phase.pairing`, `Phase.beating`, `Phase.heldSid`, `Phase.holdsBroadcast`, `Phase.withPairing(p)`;
  - inputs `Pair(request, phone, stopped)`, `PermissionsAnswered(granted)`, `Unpair`, `SetAutomatic(on)`, `SetLanguage(language)`, `ReadinessChanged(readiness)`, `CodeAnswered(requestId, answer)`, `StartAnswered(requestId, answer)`;
  - commands `AskPermissions`, `Hold`, `Release`, `Orient(side)`, `FetchCode(requestId, url, bearer, phoneId, slot, environment)`, `PostStart(requestId, url, bearer, body)`, `StopBroadcast`, `WriteStopped(record)`, `DeleteStopped(code, slot)`;
  - `SessionRecord.protect(secrets: List<String>, notInUrls: List<String> = emptyList())`.

```kotlin
  @Test
  fun `A5 pair asks for permissions, then holds the service and sends the claim at once`() {
    val rig = MachineRig()
    rig.permissions = null
    val asked = rig.send(Input.Pair(Configs.pairRequest(), Configs.PHONE, stopped = null))
    assertIs<Phase.Pairing>(rig.phase)
    assertTrue(Command.AskPermissions in asked)
    val granted = rig.send(Input.PermissionsAnswered(granted = true))
    assertIs<Phase.Paired>(rig.phase)
    assertEquals(Command.Hold, granted.first { it !is Command.Record })
```

- [ ] **Step 3: The phases.** In `Phase.kt`, `Ids` gains `val start: Int = 1`. Add `PairingState` above `Session`:

```kotlin
/**
 * One pairing (A5): what `pair` brought, and what the server has said since. Held from Pairing until
 * Idle or Ended, with each broadcast's [Session] inside it. The token is the request's: never printed.
 */
data class PairingState(
  val request: PairRequest,
  val phone: PhoneFacts,
  /** The claim the next beat carries: the request's kind until the first 2xx (A9); `resume` again while not current (G0-d). */
  val claim: Claim?,
  val automatic: Boolean,
  val language: String,
  val heartbeat: HeartbeatState,
  val waiting: WaitingFields = WaitingFields.UNKNOWN,
  /** The platform's last readiness facts (A11); the network is the phase's own fact. */
  val readiness: Readiness = Readiness.UNKNOWN,
  /** A17: this code and slot's stopped record, until delivered. */
  val stopped: StoppedRecord? = null,
  /** The stopped sid the beat in flight carried, so its answer can deliver it. */
  val stoppedInFlight: String? = null,
  /** Sids this pairing never starts or rejoins: refused starts (_Start failures_) and stopped ones (A17). */
  val refused: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  val starts: StartAsks = StartAsks(),
  val refusal: Refusal? = null,
  val startFailed: StartFailure? = null,
  val lastEnd: LastEnd? = null,
  /** A 401 heard while a broadcast is held: the pairing ends with the broadcast (the 401 deferral). */
  val codeEndedPending: Boolean = false,
  /** The fields of the last `beat` line written while paired (Task 9). */
  val lastBeatLine: List<Pair<String, Any?>>? = null,
) {
  val name: PairingName
    get() = request.name

  val token: String
    get() = request.token
}
```

```kotlin
  /** `pair` heard; the camera and microphone permissions are being asked. No beat, no service yet. */
  data class Pairing(val pairing: PairingState, val ids: Ids, val networkValidated: Boolean) : Phase {
    override val name = "pairing"
  }

  /** Paired and waiting for a Go live (A5): beating, the service and the wake lock held. */
  data class Paired(val pairing: PairingState, val ids: Ids, val networkValidated: Boolean) : Phase {
    override val name = "paired"
  }

  /**
   * A broadcast [sid] to start or rejoin, the code being fetched for its credentials (A5). [asks]
   * spaces the fetches as plan B's descriptor asks; [notBeforeMs] holds a 429's Retry-After;
   * [notCurrent] waits for a `resume` claim's answer before fetching again (G0-d); [retrying] is set
   * by an answer that was no answer, for the status line.
   */
  data class Arming(
    val pairing: PairingState,
    val sid: String,
    val cause: Cause,
    val ids: Ids,
    val networkValidated: Boolean,
    val asks: DescriptorAsks,
    val notBeforeMs: Long = 0,
    val notCurrent: Boolean = false,
    val retrying: Boolean = false,
  ) : Phase {
    override val name = "arming"
  }
```

The extensions. Every `when (this)` over phases gains the three new members; the new ones:

```kotlin
/** The pairing in any phase that has one; Ended keeps it for the snapshot and the final beat. */
val Phase.pairing: PairingState?
  get() =
    when (this) {
      is Phase.Pairing -> pairing
      is Phase.Paired -> pairing
      is Phase.Arming -> pairing
      is Phase.Armed -> session.pairing
      is Phase.Connecting -> session.pairing
      is Phase.OnAir -> session.pairing
      is Phase.Ended -> pairing
      is Phase.Idle -> null
    }

/** The pairing that beats: Paired to On air. Not while permissions are asked, not once Ended. */
val Phase.beating: PairingState?
  get() = if (this is Phase.Pairing || this is Phase.Ended) null else pairing

/** The sid the engine holds, from Arming to On air. */
val Phase.heldSid: String?
  get() =
    when (this) {
      is Phase.Arming -> sid
      else -> session?.sid
    }

val Phase.holdsBroadcast: Boolean
  get() = heldSid != null

fun Phase.withPairing(pairing: PairingState): Phase =
  when (this) {
    is Phase.Pairing -> copy(pairing = pairing)
    is Phase.Paired -> copy(pairing = pairing)
    is Phase.Arming -> copy(pairing = pairing)
    is Phase.Ended -> copy(pairing = pairing)
    is Phase.Idle -> this
    else -> withSession(session!!.copy(pairing = pairing))
  }
```

`Phase.ids` for the three new phases is `ids.copy(beat = pairing.heartbeat.nextId, start = pairing.starts.nextId)`, and Arming's adds `descriptor = asks.nextId`; `Session.ids` adds `beat = pairing.heartbeat.nextId, start = pairing.starts.nextId`. `Phase.networkValidated` and `withNetwork` read and write the new phases' own field. `Phase.ended(reason, now)` keeps `pairing` and `heldSid` in the `Ended` it builds.

```kotlin
  /** Ask for the camera and microphone (and, on Android 13+, notifications), answered as [Input.PermissionsAnswered]. */
  data object AskPermissions : Command

  /** Start the foreground service and take the partial wake lock, for the whole pairing (A5). */
  data object Hold : Command

  /** Stop the foreground service and release the wake lock. */
  data object Release : Command

  /** The broadcast's encoded rotation, before its first [Connect] (A11). */
  data class Orient(val side: Side) : Command

  /**
   * `GET url?slot=slot&phone=phoneId` with the Bearer, no-store, answered as [Input.CodeAnswered]
   * (G0-d). [environment] names the ingest host the answer's `cred` must sit on.
   */
  data class FetchCode(val requestId: Int, val url: String, val bearer: String, val phoneId: String, val slot: Int, val environment: Environment) : Command {
    override fun toString(): String = "FetchCode(requestId=$requestId, url=<${url.length} chars>, bearer=<${bearer.length} chars>)"

  /** `POST url` with the Bearer and [body], answered as [Input.StartAnswered]. */
  data class PostStart(val requestId: Int, val url: String, val bearer: String, val body: String) : Command {
    override fun toString(): String = "PostStart(requestId=$requestId, url=<${url.length} chars>, bearer=<${bearer.length} chars>)"
  }

  /** Stop publishing this broadcast; the pairing, the camera and the service stay. */
  data object StopBroadcast : Command

  /** A17: write [record] to app-private storage, synchronously, before the [End] that follows it. */
  data class WriteStopped(val record: StoppedRecord) : Command

  /** A17: the record for this code and slot is delivered, or its code ended. */
  data class DeleteStopped(val code: String, val slot: Int) : Command {
    override fun toString(): String = "DeleteStopped(slot=$slot)"
  }
```

- [ ] **Step 5: The machine.** `K/core/Pairings.kt`:

```kotlin
package com.seazn.capture.engine.core

private fun line(kind: String, vararg fields: Pair<String, Any?>): Command = Command.Record(RecordEntry(kind, fields.toList()))

/** Pairing, the settings, readiness and the start gate (amendment, _The engine port_ and A11). */
internal object Pairings {
  fun pair(phase: Phase, input: Input.Pair, now: Now): Step {
    val name = input.request.name
    if (phase.holdsBroadcast || phase is Phase.Ended) return SessionMachine.ignored(phase, "pair")
    if ((phase is Phase.Pairing || phase is Phase.Paired) && phase.pairing?.name == name) return SessionMachine.ignored(phase, "pair")
    val problems = input.request.problems()
    if (problems.isNotEmpty()) {
      val refused = line("pair-refused", "problems" to problems.joinToString("; "))
      return Step(phase.ended(EndReason.FATAL_ERROR, now), listOf(refused, Command.End(EndReason.FATAL_ERROR), Command.Release))
    }
    val left = if (phase is Phase.Paired || phase is Phase.Pairing) listOf(Command.Release, line("unpaired", "reason" to "re-pair")) else emptyList()
    val ids = phase.ids
    val stopped = input.stopped?.takeIf { it.isFor(name) && it.current(now.wallMs) }
    val pairing =
      PairingState(
        request = input.request,
        phone = input.phone,
        claim = input.request.claim,
        automatic = input.request.automatic,
        language = input.request.language,
        heartbeat = HeartbeatState(nextId = ids.beat),
        stopped = stopped,
        refused = setOfNotNull(stopped?.sid),
        starts = StartAsks(nextId = ids.start),
      )
    val asked = line("pair", "claim" to input.request.claim, "slot" to name.slot, "tokenTag" to name.tokenTag, "stopped" to (stopped != null))
    return Step(Phase.Pairing(pairing, ids, phase.networkValidated), left + asked + Command.AskPermissions)
  }

  fun permissions(phase: Phase, granted: Boolean, now: Now): Step {
    if (phase !is Phase.Pairing) return Step(phase, listOf(line("permissions-late", "granted" to granted)))
    if (!granted) {
      val idle = Phase.Idle(phase.ids, phase.networkValidated, Unpaired(UnpairReason.PERMISSIONS, phase.pairing.name))
      return Step(idle, listOf(line("unpaired", "reason" to UnpairReason.PERMISSIONS)))
    }
    val paired = Phase.Paired(phase.pairing.copy(heartbeat = phase.pairing.heartbeat.soon(now.monoMs)), phase.ids, phase.networkValidated)
    // The claim goes at once (A9): the first beat is due now.
    return Heartbeats.tick(Step(paired, listOf(Command.Hold, line("paired"))), now)
  }

  fun unpair(phase: Phase): Step =
    when (phase) {
      is Phase.Paired -> Step(Phase.Idle(phase.ids, phase.networkValidated), listOf(Command.Release, line("unpaired", "reason" to "operator")))
      is Phase.Pairing -> Step(Phase.Idle(phase.ids, phase.networkValidated), listOf(line("unpaired", "reason" to "operator")))
      else -> SessionMachine.ignored(phase, "unpair")
    }

  /** The engine leaves the pairing without the operator asking: the code is forgotten by JS (A9, the 401 rule). */
  fun unpaired(phase: Phase, reason: UnpairReason, now: Now): Step {
    val pairing = phase.pairing ?: return Step(phase)
    val commands = mutableListOf<Command>()
    if (phase is Phase.Connecting || phase is Phase.OnAir) commands += Command.StopBroadcast
    commands += Command.Release
    if (reason == UnpairReason.CODE_ENDED && pairing.stopped != null) commands += Command.DeleteStopped(pairing.name.code, pairing.name.slot)
    commands += line("unpaired", "reason" to reason, "wasLive" to (phase.session?.liveSinceEpochMs != null))
    return Step(Phase.Idle(phase.ids, phase.networkValidated, Unpaired(reason, pairing.name)), commands)
  }

  fun automatic(phase: Phase, on: Boolean): Step {
    val pairing = phase.pairing?.takeIf { phase !is Phase.Ended } ?: return SessionMachine.ignored(phase, "set-automatic")
    return Step(phase.withPairing(pairing.copy(automatic = on)), listOf(line("automatic", "on" to on)))
  }

  fun language(phase: Phase, language: String): Step {
    val pairing = phase.pairing?.takeIf { phase !is Phase.Ended } ?: return SessionMachine.ignored(phase, "set-language")
    return Step(phase.withPairing(pairing.copy(language = language)))
  }

  /** A fact, not an intent: kept in any paired phase, dropped otherwise (the bridge replays it at pair). */
  fun readiness(phase: Phase, readiness: Readiness): Step {
    val pairing = phase.pairing?.takeIf { phase !is Phase.Ended } ?: return Step(phase)
    return Step(phase.withPairing(pairing.copy(readiness = readiness)))
  }

  /**
   * A11: Armed connects on its own once native judges the phone ready, held or remote, one gate. The
   * side held becomes the broadcast's encoded rotation, read once, here. Run after every input.
   */
  fun gate(step: Step, now: Now): Step {
    val armed = step.phase as? Phase.Armed ?: return step
    val session = armed.session
    if (session.pairing.readiness.notReady(session.camera, session.networkValidated) != null) return step
    val side = session.pairing.readiness.side
    val connected = Transports.connect(session.copy(side = side), session.fallback.current, outage = null, now = now)
    return connected.copy(commands = step.commands + Command.Orient(side) + line("ready", "side" to side) + connected.commands)
  }
}

/** Arming: the code fetched for one broadcast's credentials (A5, _Who reads what_). */
internal object Starts {
  /** Arming for [sid]: the line the operator saw is cleared, and the code is fetched at once. */
  fun arm(phase: Phase, pairing: PairingState, sid: String, cause: Cause, now: Now): Step {
    val ids = phase.ids
    val cleared = pairing.copy(refusal = null, startFailed = null, lastEnd = null)
    val (asks, id) = DescriptorAsks(nextId = ids.descriptor).asked(now.monoMs)
    val arming = Phase.Arming(cleared, sid, cause, ids, phase.networkValidated, asks)
    val fetch = Command.FetchCode(id, pairing.request.codeUrl, pairing.token, pairing.phone.phoneId, pairing.name.slot, pairing.request.environment)
    return Step(arming, listOf(line("broadcast-start", "sid" to sid, "cause" to cause), fetch))
  }

  /** An open session shape for the sid in hand: the broadcast's plan, then Armed. */
  fun opened(arming: Phase.Arming, answer: CodeAnswer.Open): Step {
    val pairing = answer.waiting?.let { arming.pairing.copy(waiting = it) } ?: arming.pairing
    val descriptor = answer.descriptor
    val config = descriptor.config(arming.sid, pairing)
    val ids = arming.ids
    val session =
      Session(
        pairing = pairing,
        sid = arming.sid,
        cause = arming.cause,
        broadcast = descriptor,
        config = config,
        fallback = FallbackPolicy(config.primary.transport, config.fallback?.transport),
        regulation = BitrateRegulator.sessionStarted(),
        delivery = DeliveryWatch(config.playbackUrl, nextRequestId = ids.playlist),
        nextAttemptId = ids.attempt,
        descriptor = arming.asks,
        networkValidated = arming.networkValidated,
      )
    val armed = line("armed", "sid" to arming.sid, "transport" to config.primary.transport, "srtOffered" to descriptor.srtOffered, "playbackUrl" to config.playbackUrl)
    return Step(Phase.Armed(session), listOf(armed))
  }

  /** The tick in Arming: fetch again once the asks' spacing and any Retry-After allow, unless a claim is awaited. */
  fun tick(arming: Phase.Arming, now: Now): Step {
    if (arming.notCurrent || now.monoMs < arming.notBeforeMs || !arming.asks.mayAsk(now.monoMs)) return Step(arming)
    val (asks, id) = arming.asks.asked(now.monoMs)
    val fetch = Command.FetchCode(id, arming.pairing.request.codeUrl, arming.pairing.token, arming.pairing.phone.phoneId, arming.pairing.name.slot, arming.pairing.request.environment)
    return Step(arming.copy(asks = asks), listOf(fetch))
  }
}
```


and `PairRequest` gains `fun secrets(): List<String> = listOf(token).filter { it.isNotBlank() }` and `fun textSecrets(): List<String> = listOf(code).filter { it.isNotBlank() }`. **The code is kept out of the record at field level (M3):** no line the machine writes names it (the `pair` line carries `slot` and `tokenTag`), and it is masked by value only in free text (`TEXT_KEYS`: `message`, `problems`), where a library's error can quote a URL holding it. It is never masked inside a closed-vocabulary word or a kind, so a short code cannot mangle `connecting` because it contains `on`. The token stays masked everywhere, as plan B did (Global Constraints, security). A scanned code's raw value never reaches native: JS sends the parsed fields.

In `SessionMachine.kt`, `apply`'s table becomes:

```kotlin
  private fun apply(phase: Phase, input: Input, now: Now): Step =
    when (input) {
      is Input.Pair -> Pairings.pair(phase, input, now)
      is Input.PermissionsAnswered -> Pairings.permissions(phase, input.granted, now)
      Input.Unpair -> Pairings.unpair(phase)
      is Input.SetAutomatic -> Pairings.automatic(phase, input.on)
      is Input.SetLanguage -> Pairings.language(phase, input.language)
      is Input.ReadinessChanged -> Pairings.readiness(phase, input.readiness)
      Input.Start -> Verdicts.postStart(phase, now)
      Input.Stop -> if (!phase.holdsBroadcast) ignored(phase, "stop") else end(phase, EndReason.OPERATOR_STOPPED, now)
      Input.Reset -> if (phase is Phase.Ended) Step(Phase.Idle(phase.ids, phase.networkValidated), listOf(record("reset"))) else ignored(phase, "reset")
      Input.SwitchCamera -> Devices.switched(phase, now)
      Input.Tick -> Heartbeats.tick(Timers.tick(phase, now), now)
      // … plan B's platform facts, unchanged …
      is Input.HeartbeatAnswered -> Heartbeats.answered(phase, input, now)
      is Input.CodeAnswered -> Verdicts.code(phase, input, now)
      is Input.StartAnswered -> Verdicts.started(phase, input, now)
      is Input.PlatformFailed -> platformFailed(phase, input, now)
    }
```

`Verdicts`, in a new section of `Pairings.kt`, holds what Task 5 needs of the answers; Tasks 6 and 7 complete it:

```kotlin
/** The answer table (amendment), by phase. Task 5 has the go-live and the open shape; Tasks 6 and 7 the rest. */
internal object Verdicts {
  /** The server's word on a beat, after the pairing's own bookkeeping ([Heartbeats.answered]). */
  fun beat(phase: Phase, word: ServerWord, now: Now): Step {
    val pairing = phase.pairing ?: return Step(phase)
    if (phase is Phase.Paired && word is ServerWord.Open && word.sid !in pairing.refused) {
      return Starts.arm(phase, pairing, word.sid, word.cause ?: Cause.ORGANISER, now)
    }
    return Step(phase)
  }

  /** The code's answer at Arming. Only the ask in flight is acted on (plan B's B6 review I2). */
  fun code(phase: Phase, input: Input.CodeAnswered, now: Now): Step {
    if (phase !is Phase.Arming) return Step(phase)
    val asks = phase.asks.answered(input.requestId) ?: return Step(phase)
    val answered = phase.copy(asks = asks)
    val answer = input.answer
    if (answer is CodeAnswer.Open && answer.sid == phase.sid) return Starts.opened(answered, answer)
    return Step(answered, listOf(line("code", "answer" to answer::class.simpleName)))
  }

  fun started(phase: Phase, input: Input.StartAnswered, now: Now): Step = Step(phase)

  fun postStart(phase: Phase, now: Now): Step = SessionMachine.ignored(phase, "start")
}
```

`Heartbeats` beats from the pairing:

```kotlin
/** The pairing's beats (amendment, _Contract shapes_): Paired to On air, never gating anything. */
internal object Heartbeats {
  fun tick(step: Step, now: Now): Step {
    val phase = step.phase
    val pairing = phase.beating ?: return step
    val held = phase.heldSid
    val interval = BeatCadence.intervalMs(pairing.waiting.pollSeconds, held = held != null)
    val (heartbeat, id) = Heartbeat.due(pairing.heartbeat, now.monoMs, now.wallMs, interval)
    val commands = step.commands.toMutableList()
    if (heartbeat.failures > pairing.heartbeat.failures) commands += record("heartbeat", "result" to HeartbeatResult.FAILED, "message" to "no answer")
    if (id == null) return Step(phase.withPairing(pairing.copy(heartbeat = heartbeat)), commands)
    // RR3: the stopped sid rides only a beat that holds none.
    val carried = if (held == null) pairing.stopped?.sid else null
    val next = pairing.copy(heartbeat = heartbeat, stoppedInFlight = carried)
    val nextPhase = phase.withPairing(next)
    val body = Beats.payload(Projection.beatFacts(nextPhase, next, now))
    commands += Command.PostHeartbeat(id, pairing.request.heartbeatUrl, pairing.token, body)
    return Step(nextPhase, commands)
  }

  fun answered(phase: Phase, input: Input.HeartbeatAnswered, now: Now): Step {
    val pairing = phase.beating ?: return Step(phase)
    val heartbeat = Heartbeat.answered(pairing.heartbeat, input.beatId, input.response, now.monoMs)
    if (heartbeat == pairing.heartbeat) return Step(phase)
    val response = input.response as? HeartbeatResponse.Answered
    val word = ServerWord.ofBeat(input.response, named = phase.heldSid ?: pairing.stoppedInFlight)
    val ok = response != null && response.status in 200..299
    val refreshed =
      pairing.copy(
        heartbeat = heartbeat,
        claim = if (ok) null else pairing.claim,
        waiting = response?.reply?.waiting?.takeIf { ok } ?: pairing.waiting,
        stoppedInFlight = null,
      )
    val noted = record("heartbeat", "result" to heartbeat.lastResult, "status" to response?.status, "word" to word::class.simpleName, "message" to (input.response as? HeartbeatResponse.Failed)?.message)
    val decided = Verdicts.beat(phase.withPairing(refreshed), word, now)
    return decided.copy(commands = listOf(noted) + decided.commands)
  }
}
```

`Heartbeat.answered` loses its boolean (Task 3's `SessionOver` read goes with it): it returns the state alone, `SESSION_OVER` set when `ServerWord.ofBeat` is `Over`, and `HeartbeatState` gains `fun soon(nowMs: Long) = copy(lastSentAtMonoMs = null, notBeforeMs = nowMs)`. Delete `HeartbeatFacts`, `Heartbeat.payload`, `SessionOver.kt`, `SessionOverTest.kt`: `ServerWordTest` covers every row they did.

```kotlin
  /** One beat's facts (amendment, _Contract shapes_). `audioOk` as plan B's carry 8. */
  fun beatFacts(phase: Phase, pairing: PairingState, now: Now): BeatFacts {
    val session = phase.session
    val onAir = phase as? Phase.OnAir
    val snapshot = snapshot(phase, now)
    val audioFps = onAir?.watchdog?.audioFps
    return BeatFacts(
      code = pairing.name.code,
      slot = pairing.name.slot,
      phoneId = pairing.phone.phoneId,
      claim = pairing.claim,
      deviceModel = pairing.phone.model,
      sid = phase.heldSid,
      atEpochMs = now.wallMs,
      state = snapshot.state.wire,
      cause = session?.cause ?: (phase as? Phase.Arming)?.cause,
      notReady = pairing.readiness.notReady(session?.camera ?: CameraState.OWN, phase.networkValidated),
      startFailed = pairing.startFailed,
      stopped = pairing.stoppedInFlight,
      automatic = pairing.automatic,
      transport = onAir?.transport ?: (phase as? Phase.Connecting)?.transport,
      bitrateKbps = snapshot.bitrateKbps,
      delivery = snapshot.delivery,
      deliveredLagMs = snapshot.deliveredLagMs,
      audioOk = session != null && !session.micSilenced && audioFps != null && audioFps >= StallWatchdog.AUDIO_FLOOR_FPS,
      batteryPercent = session?.device?.batteryPercent,
      charging = session?.device?.charging,
      drainPctPerHour = session?.device?.drainPctPerHour,
      thermalStatus = session?.device?.thermalStatus,
      dataUsedBytes = session?.dataUsedBytes ?: 0,
      appVersion = pairing.phone.appVersion,
    )
```

In `Engine.kt`, `reduced` protects before the machine sees a secret:

```kotlin
  private fun reduced(input: Input, now: Now): Step =
    try {
      val unprotected = protectFailure(input)
      // A secret that could not be protected is never handed to an input that would act on it.
      if (unprotected != null && acts(input)) throw unprotected
      val reduced = reducer(phase, input, now)
      if (unprotected == null) reduced else reduced.copy(commands = listOf(engineError(unprotected)) + reduced.commands)
    } catch (failure: Exception) {
      if (phase is Phase.Ended) Step(phase, listOf(engineError(failure)))
      else Step(phase.ended(EndReason.FATAL_ERROR, now), listOf(engineError(failure), Command.End(EndReason.FATAL_ERROR), Command.Release))
    }

  /** A pair from Idle or Paired, or a code answer at Arming: the inputs whose secrets reach the platform. */
  private fun acts(input: Input): Boolean =
    (input is Input.Pair && (phase is Phase.Idle || phase is Phase.Paired)) || (input is Input.CodeAnswered && phase is Phase.Arming)

  private fun protectFailure(input: Input): Exception? =
    try {
      when (input) {
        is Input.Pair -> record.protect(input.request.secrets(), inTextOnly = input.request.textSecrets())
        is Input.CodeAnswered -> (input.answer as? CodeAnswer.Open)?.descriptor?.let { record.protect(it.secrets(), notInUrls = it.streamIds()) }
        else -> Unit
      }
      null
    } catch (failure: Exception) {
      failure
    }
```

`SessionRecord.protect(config)` becomes `protect(secrets: List<String>, notInUrls: List<String> = emptyList(), inTextOnly: List<String> = emptyList())`, with the same body over `secrets` and `secrets - notInUrls`, and `textSecrets = withEncodings(textSecrets + inTextOnly)` in a new field. `scrub`'s `key in PLAIN_KEYS || key in TEXT_KEYS -> masked(value, secrets)` splits in two: `key in TEXT_KEYS -> masked(value, secrets + textSecrets)` first, then `key in PLAIN_KEYS -> masked(value, secrets)`; the kind is masked with `secrets` alone. Plan B's callers pass `config.secrets()` and the stream ids.

Its auto-answers gain `permissions: Boolean? = true` (for `AskPermissions`), `codes: ((Int) -> CodeAnswer?)? = { Configs.open(descriptor = descriptor) }` (for `FetchCode`) and `starts: ((Int) -> StartAnswer?)? = null` (for `PostStart`). Its helpers:

```kotlin
  /** Paired: the pair, permissions granted, the network fact, and the claim beat in flight. */
  fun paired(validated: Boolean = true): MachineRig {
    send(Input.Pair(request, Configs.PHONE, stopped = null))
    send(Input.Network(validated))
    return this
  }

  /** Answers the beat in flight, ticking until one is; fails after two minutes with none. */
  fun hear(state: String?, sid: String? = null, startedBy: String? = null, endReason: String? = null, status: Int = 200, pollSeconds: Int = 10): List<Command> {
    val until = mono + 120_000
    while (phase.beating?.heartbeat?.inFlightId == null) {
      check(mono < until) { "no beat in flight in ${phase.name}" }
      advance(500)
    }
    val id = phase.beating!!.heartbeat.inFlightId!!
    val reply = BeatReply(state, sid, startedBy, endReason, Configs.waiting(pollSeconds))
    return send(Input.HeartbeatAnswered(id, HeartbeatResponse.Answered(status, reply)))
  }

  /** Armed for `sess_42`, by the organiser's Go live, and not yet ready. */
  fun armed(validated: Boolean = true): MachineRig {
    paired(validated)
    hear("go-live", sid = "sess_42", startedBy = "organiser")
    return this
  }

  fun ready(readiness: Readiness = Configs.READY): List<Command> = send(Input.ReadinessChanged(readiness))

  /** Armed, ready, connected, and a second of encoded frames: LIVE. */
  fun live(): MachineRig {
    armed()
    ready()
    send(Input.Connected(attempt!!))
    advance(1_000)
    return this
  }
```

**The four questions.** (1) A second call: `pair` is idempotent on the same code, slot and token while Pairing or Paired; a `pair` on another code unpairs first; `pair` and `unpair` while a broadcast is held are ignored. (2) An empty input: a pair request with problems ends fatal-error and never asks for permissions; readiness heard before the go-live is kept. (3) After an interruption: a refused permission does not pair and is not sticky — the next `pair` asks again; a permission answer after the pairing left Pairing is `permissions-late`. (4) Another mode, orientation or language: the side read once when Armed turns to Connecting; `setAutomatic` and `setLanguage` in every paired phase, ignored in Idle.

Every phase × every answer, as the amendment's _The answer table_ lists it, one test per row. Broadcasts that end without the operator now return to Paired with their `lastEnd` (amendment §5: "an organiser stop returns to Paired with its line"), so `EndReason` keeps only the two ends that end a pairing, `operator-stopped` and `fatal-error`. A hold window that runs out returns to Paired too, with `hold-window-expired`: the server may have kept the broadcast open, and the next beat's `live` rejoins it (A10).

```kotlin
class AnswerTableTest {

  @Test fun `waiting while paired changes nothing`() {
    val rig = MachineRig().paired()
    rig.hear("waiting")
    assertIs<Phase.Paired>(rig.phase)

    val rig = MachineRig().armed()

    assertTrue(rig.sent<Command.StopBroadcast>().isEmpty())

    val rig = MachineRig().live()
    rig.hear("waiting")
    assertEquals(LastEnd.STOPPED, paired(rig).lastEnd)
    assertEquals(1, rig.sent<Command.StopBroadcast>().size)
  }

    rig.codes = null
    rig.hear("go-live", sid = "sess_43", startedBy = "automatic")
    assertEquals(Cause.AUTOMATIC, assertIs<Phase.Arming>(rig.phase).cause)

  }

  @Test fun `live N on air - S is over, end it, then Arming for N, a rejoin`() {
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement.** `Verdicts.beat` and `Verdicts.code` become:

```kotlin
  fun beat(phase: Phase, word: ServerWord, now: Now): Step {
    val pairing = phase.pairing ?: return Step(phase)
    if (word is ServerWord.Open && word.sid in pairing.refused) return Step(phase, listOf(line("open-ignored", "sid" to word.sid)))
    return when (phase) {
      is Phase.Paired -> paired(phase, pairing, word, now)
      is Phase.Arming, is Phase.Armed, is Phase.Connecting, is Phase.OnAir -> held(phase, pairing, word, now)
      else -> Step(phase)
    }
  }

  private fun paired(phase: Phase.Paired, pairing: PairingState, word: ServerWord, now: Now): Step =
    when (word) {
      is ServerWord.Open -> Starts.arm(phase, pairing, word.sid, word.cause ?: Cause.ORGANISER, now)
      ServerWord.Replaced -> Pairings.unpaired(phase, UnpairReason.REPLACED, now)
      ServerWord.Taken -> Pairings.unpaired(phase, UnpairReason.TAKEN, now)
      ServerWord.CodeEnded -> Pairings.unpaired(phase, UnpairReason.CODE_ENDED, now)
      else -> Step(phase)
    }

  private fun held(phase: Phase, pairing: PairingState, word: ServerWord, now: Now): Step {
    val held = phase.heldSid!!
    return when {
      word == ServerWord.Replaced -> Pairings.unpaired(phase, UnpairReason.REPLACED, now)
      word == ServerWord.CodeEnded && phase is Phase.Arming -> Pairings.unpaired(phase, UnpairReason.CODE_ENDED, now)
      word == ServerWord.CodeEnded -> Step(phase.withPairing(pairing.copy(codeEndedPending = true)), listOf(line("code-ended-pending")))
      word == ServerWord.NotFound && phase is Phase.Arming -> Starts.failed(phase, StartFailure.NOT_FOUND)
      word is ServerWord.Open && word.sid == held -> if (phase is Phase.Arming && phase.notCurrent) Starts.claimed(phase, now) else Step(phase)
      word is ServerWord.Open -> {
        val over = over(phase, LastEnd.STOPPED, now)
        val next = over.phase as? Phase.Paired ?: return over
        val armed = Starts.arm(next, next.pairing, word.sid, word.cause ?: Cause.ORGANISER, now)
        armed.copy(commands = over.commands + armed.commands)
      }
      word.ends(held) -> over(phase, LastEnd.of((word as? ServerWord.Over)?.endReason), now)
      else -> Step(phase)
    }
  }

  /**
   * The held broadcast is over without the operator: back to Paired with [lastEnd], or, after a 401
   * heard while it was held, to Idle with code-ended (the 401 deferral).
   */
  fun over(phase: Phase, lastEnd: LastEnd, now: Now): Step {
    val pairing = phase.pairing ?: return Step(phase)
    if (pairing.codeEndedPending) return Pairings.unpaired(phase, UnpairReason.CODE_ENDED, now)
    val publishing = phase is Phase.Connecting || phase is Phase.OnAir
    val ended = line("broadcast-ended", "sid" to phase.heldSid, "lastEnd" to lastEnd, "wasLive" to (phase.session?.liveSinceEpochMs != null))
    val paired = Phase.Paired(pairing.copy(lastEnd = lastEnd), phase.ids, phase.networkValidated)
    return Step(paired, listOfNotNull(if (publishing) Command.StopBroadcast else null, ended))
  }

  fun code(phase: Phase, input: Input.CodeAnswered, now: Now): Step {
    val held = phase.heldSid ?: return Step(phase)
    return if (phase is Phase.Arming) Starts.answered(phase, input, now) else reconnectAnswer(phase, held, input, now)
  }

  /** A reconnect's fetch (plan B: on every reconnect): only the over verdicts act; anything else is recorded. */
  private fun reconnectAnswer(phase: Phase, held: String, input: Input.CodeAnswered, now: Now): Step {
    val session = phase.session ?: return Step(phase)
    val asks = session.descriptor.answered(input.requestId) ?: return Step(phase)
    val answered = phase.withSession(session.copy(descriptor = asks))
    val word = ServerWord.ofCode(input.answer, held)
    // One rule for the server's word: Over(S), NoBroadcast and another sid (with or without cred, M8) end S.
    if (word.ends(held)) return over(answered, LastEnd.of((word as? ServerWord.Over)?.endReason), now)
    return Step(answered, listOf(line("code", "answer" to input.answer::class.simpleName)))
  }
```

`Starts.answered`, `Starts.failed` and `Starts.claimed` are Task 7's; in this task `Starts.answered` holds Task 5's `Open` rule plus these two rows, which the table above tests:

```kotlin
  fun answered(arming: Phase.Arming, input: Input.CodeAnswered, now: Now): Step {
    val asks = arming.asks.answered(input.requestId) ?: return Step(arming)
    val answered = arming.copy(asks = asks, retrying = false)
    val answer = input.answer
    if (answer is CodeAnswer.Open && answer.sid == arming.sid) return opened(answered, answer)
    val word = ServerWord.ofCode(answer, arming.sid)
    if (word is ServerWord.Over && word.ends(arming.sid)) return Verdicts.over(answered, LastEnd.of(word.endReason), now)
    if (word == ServerWord.NoBroadcast) return Verdicts.over(answered, LastEnd.STOPPED, now)
    return Step(answered, listOf(line("code", "answer" to answer::class.simpleName)))
  }
```

`Timers.expired` becomes `Verdicts.over(phase, LastEnd.HOLD_WINDOW_EXPIRED, now)` plus its record line `hold-expired {transport, cause}`. `EndReason` keeps `OPERATOR_STOPPED` and `FATAL_ERROR`.

**The four questions.** (1) A second call: `go-live` or `live` for the held `sid` is a confirmation in every held phase; a `go-live` or `live` naming a refused `sid` is ignored; `over` for another `sid` changes nothing. (2) An empty input: `waiting` while paired changes nothing; a waiting-shaped code at Arming is no broadcast, back to Paired, the `sid` not refused. (3) After an interruption: a hold that runs out returns to Paired and a later `live` rejoins; the 401 deferral never ends a broadcast; 404, 429, 5xx and no answer are counted in every phase. (4) Another mode, orientation or language: every row in each of Paired, Arming, Armed and on air.

### Task 7: Starting — the operator's hold, Arming's answers, and the start-failure table

The operator's Go live hold is `POST start` from Paired when ready; a beat's `go-live` starts without it. Arming fetches the code and acts on every row of the amendment's _Start failures_. A refused `sid` is never retried from beat answers. A session shape with no `cred` is "not current": a `resume` claim goes at once, and the code is fetched again when the claim is answered with the same `sid` (G0-d). A late `POST start` answer never moves the engine.

**The camera across the pairing (A11).** The capture opens on the viewfinder while Paired (CD37), so another app can take the camera before any go-live. Plan B kept the camera on the session alone, and `Devices` dropped a contention heard with no session, so a broadcast armed over a taken camera started as ours. Here the pairing keeps the camera while no broadcast is held, a broadcast starts from it, and a broadcast that ends hands it back. The slate, a picture sent in our camera's place, goes up only while sending (Connecting or On air): Armed sends nothing.

```kotlin
  /** The operator's hold: `POST start` from Paired when ready (A11); one in flight at a time. */
  fun postStart(phase: Phase, now: Now): Step {
    if (phase !is Phase.Paired) return SessionMachine.ignored(phase, "start")
    val pairing = phase.pairing
    val notReady = pairing.readiness.notReady(pairing.camera, phase.networkValidated)
    if (notReady != null || pairing.starts.inFlightId != null) return SessionMachine.ignored(phase, "start")
    val id = pairing.starts.nextId
    val asked = pairing.copy(starts = StartAsks(id + 1, id), refusal = null, startFailed = null, lastEnd = null)
    val post = Command.PostStart(id, pairing.request.startUrl, pairing.token, Beats.startBody(pairing.phone.phoneId))
    return Step(phase.withPairing(asked), listOf(post, line("start-asked")))
  }

  /** `POST start`'s answer. In Paired it decides; anywhere else it is late, and never moves the engine. */
  fun started(phase: Phase, input: Input.StartAnswered, now: Now): Step {
    val pairing = phase.pairing ?: return Step(phase)
    if (pairing.starts.inFlightId != input.requestId) return Step(phase)
    val answered = phase.withPairing(pairing.copy(starts = pairing.starts.copy(inFlightId = null)))
    val noted = line("start-answered", "answer" to input.answer::class.simpleName)
    if (answered !is Phase.Paired) return Step(answered, listOf(noted))
    val p = answered.pairing
    val step =
      when (val answer = input.answer) {
        is StartAnswer.Started -> if (answer.sid in p.refused) Step(answered) else Starts.arm(answered, p, answer.sid, Cause.OPERATOR, now)
        is StartAnswer.AlreadyLive -> if (answer.sid in p.refused) Step(answered) else Starts.arm(answered, p, answer.sid, Cause.startedBy(answer.startedBy), now)
        StartAnswer.Replaced -> Pairings.unpaired(answered, UnpairReason.REPLACED, now)
        is StartAnswer.Refused -> Step(answered.withPairing(p.copy(refusal = answer.refusal)), listOf(line("start-refused", "refusal" to answer.refusal, "message" to answer.message)))
        is StartAnswer.Failed -> Step(answered.withPairing(p.copy(refusal = Refusal.START_FAILED, startFailed = StartFailure.START_ERROR)))
      }
    return step.copy(commands = listOf(noted) + step.commands)
  }
```

`Starts` completes:

```kotlin
  fun answered(arming: Phase.Arming, input: Input.CodeAnswered, now: Now): Step {
    val asks = arming.asks.answered(input.requestId) ?: return Step(arming)
    val answered = arming.copy(asks = asks, retrying = false)
    val sid = arming.sid
    return when (val answer = input.answer) {
      is CodeAnswer.Open ->
        if (answer.sid != sid) Verdicts.over(answered, LastEnd.STOPPED, now)
        else if (answer.descriptor.config(sid, arming.pairing).problems().isNotEmpty()) failed(answered, StartFailure.CONFIG)
        else opened(answered, answer)
      is CodeAnswer.Over -> if (answer.sid == sid) Verdicts.over(answered, LastEnd.of(answer.endReason), now) else Step(answered)
      is CodeAnswer.Waiting -> Verdicts.over(answered, LastEnd.STOPPED, now)
      is CodeAnswer.NotCurrent -> if (answer.sid != sid) Verdicts.over(answered, LastEnd.STOPPED, now) else notCurrent(answered, now)
      is CodeAnswer.ForeignIngest -> failed(answered, StartFailure.CRED_HOST, line("cred-host-refused", "sid" to sid))
      is CodeAnswer.Unreadable -> failed(answered, StartFailure.CONFIG, line("code-unreadable", "problem" to answer.problem))
      is CodeAnswer.Status ->
        when (answer.status) {
          401 -> Pairings.unpaired(answered, UnpairReason.CODE_ENDED, now)
          404 -> failed(answered, StartFailure.NOT_FOUND)
          410 -> Verdicts.over(answered, LastEnd.of(answer.endReason), now)
          429 -> Step(answered.copy(notBeforeMs = now.monoMs + BeatCadence.retryAfterMs(answer.retryAfterS ?: 0), retrying = true), listOf(line("code", "status" to 429)))
          else -> Step(answered.copy(retrying = true), listOf(line("code", "status" to answer.status)))
        }
      is CodeAnswer.Unreachable -> Step(answered.copy(retrying = true), listOf(line("code", "answer" to "unreachable", "message" to answer.message)))
    }
  }

  /** A start that failed for S: back to Paired, S refused for this pairing, the line until the next start. */
  fun failed(arming: Phase.Arming, failure: StartFailure, vararg extra: Command): Step {
    val pairing = arming.pairing.copy(refused = arming.pairing.refused + arming.sid, startFailed = failure, refusal = Refusal.START_FAILED)
    val noted = line("start-failed", "sid" to arming.sid, "failure" to failure)
    return Step(Phase.Paired(pairing, arming.ids, arming.networkValidated), extra.toList() + noted)
  }

  /** G0-d: not the current phone yet. A `resume` claim at once, so it can never take the slot. */
  private fun notCurrent(arming: Phase.Arming, now: Now): Step {
    val pairing = arming.pairing.copy(claim = Claim.RESUME, heartbeat = arming.pairing.heartbeat.soon(now.monoMs))
    return Step(arming.copy(pairing = pairing, notCurrent = true), listOf(line("not-current", "sid" to arming.sid)))
  }

  /** The claim was answered naming S: fetch the code again, spaced as the asks are. */
  fun claimed(arming: Phase.Arming, now: Now): Step {
    val cleared = arming.copy(notCurrent = false, notBeforeMs = 0)
    val (asks, id) = cleared.asks.asked(now.monoMs)
    val fetch = Command.FetchCode(id, arming.pairing.request.codeUrl, arming.pairing.token, arming.pairing.phone.phoneId, arming.pairing.name.slot, arming.pairing.request.environment)
    return Step(cleared.copy(asks = asks), listOf(fetch))
  }
```

`Starts.arm` refuses nothing itself: the refused check is `Verdicts.beat`'s, and `started`'s for `POST start`'s sids. `SessionMachine.ignored` for `start` keeps the hold's own guard visible in the record.

```kotlin
  /** I2: the slate is a picture sent in our camera's place, so it goes up only while sending. Armed sends nothing. */
  private fun sending(phase: Phase) = phase is Phase.Connecting || phase is Phase.OnAir

  fun contended(phase: Phase): Step {
    val session = phase.session ?: return onPairing(phase, CameraState.TAKEN, record("camera-taken")) { it != CameraState.TAKEN }
    if (session.camera == CameraState.TAKEN) return Step(phase)
    val next = phase.withSession(session.copy(camera = CameraState.TAKEN))
    // Taken again mid-reopen: the slate never came down, so it is not put up twice.
    val slate = if (!sending(phase) || session.camera.slateOnAir) emptyList() else listOf(Command.Slate(on = true))
    return Step(next, slate + record("camera-taken"))
  }

  fun released(phase: Phase): Step {
    val session = phase.session ?: return onPairing(phase, CameraState.REOPENING, Command.ReopenCamera, record("camera-released")) { it == CameraState.TAKEN }
    if (session.camera != CameraState.TAKEN) return Step(phase)
    return Step(phase.withSession(session.copy(camera = CameraState.REOPENING)), listOf(Command.ReopenCamera, record("camera-released")))
  }

  fun reopened(phase: Phase, ok: Boolean, now: Now): Step {
    val session = phase.session ?: return onPairing(phase, CameraState.OWN, record("camera-reopened", "ok" to ok)) { it == CameraState.REOPENING }
    if (session.camera != CameraState.REOPENING) return Step(phase)
    val own = phase.withSession(session.copy(camera = CameraState.OWN))
    val commands = (if (sending(phase)) listOf(Command.Slate(on = false)) else emptyList()) + record("camera-reopened", "ok" to ok)
    if (own !is Phase.OnAir) return Step(own, commands)
    // … plan B's On air branch, unchanged …
  }

  /** I3: no broadcast held, so the pairing keeps the camera. No slate: nothing is sent. Ended keeps nothing. */
  private fun onPairing(phase: Phase, to: CameraState, vararg commands: Command, from: (CameraState) -> Boolean): Step {
    val pairing = phase.pairing?.takeIf { phase !is Phase.Ended && from(it.camera) } ?: return Step(phase)
    return Step(phase.withPairing(pairing.copy(camera = to)), commands.toList())
  }
```

### Task 8: The operator's Stop — A8's final beat, A17's record, and the release

The operator's Stop ends the broadcast and the pairing (A3). From a broadcast whose first encoded frame went out, one final beat goes beside `Command.End`, and the service is released when it answers or after 10 s. Every Stop from Arming on writes the stopped record before `End`. The record rides every paired beat of the next pairing of that code and slot until delivered; while it exists, its `sid` is never rejoined.

- Create: `T/core/StopTest.kt`

**Interfaces:**

- Produces: `Phase.Ended(reason, ids, durationMs, networkValidated, pairing, sid, finalBeatId, finalBeatAtMs)`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement.** `SessionMachine.end` becomes:

```kotlin
  /**
   * The pairing is over: the operator's Stop (A3) or a fatal error. A Stop writes A17's record before
   * End; from a broadcast that went live it sends A8's one final beat and holds the service for it.
   */
  internal fun end(phase: Phase, reason: EndReason, now: Now, vararg fields: Pair<String, Any?>): Step {
    val pairing = phase.pairing
    val sid = phase.heldSid
    val wasLive = phase.session?.liveSinceEpochMs != null
    val ended = phase.ended(reason, now)
    val commands = mutableListOf<Command>(record("ended", "reason" to reason, "wasLive" to wasLive, *fields))
    if (reason == EndReason.OPERATOR_STOPPED && pairing != null && sid != null) {
      commands += Command.WriteStopped(StoppedRecord.of(pairing.name, sid, now.wallMs, phase.session?.broadcast?.maxDurationMinutes))
    }
    commands += Command.End(reason)
    if (reason == EndReason.OPERATOR_STOPPED && wasLive && pairing != null) {
      val (beat, id) = finalBeat(phase, pairing, now)
      commands += beat
      return Step(ended.copy(pairing = pairing.copy(heartbeat = pairing.heartbeat.copy(nextId = id + 1, inFlightId = null)), finalBeatId = id, finalBeatAtMs = now.monoMs), commands)
    }
    commands += Command.Release
    return Step(ended, commands)
  }

  /** A8: `{sid, state:"ended", endReason:"operator-stopped"}`, once, never retried. */
  private fun finalBeat(phase: Phase, pairing: PairingState, now: Now): Pair<Command, Int> {
    val id = pairing.heartbeat.nextId
    val facts = Projection.beatFacts(phase, pairing, now).copy(state = "ended", claim = null, deviceModel = null, endReason = EndReason.OPERATOR_STOPPED)
    return Command.PostHeartbeat(id, pairing.request.heartbeatUrl, pairing.token, Beats.payload(facts)) to id
  }
```

`Ended` handles its two inputs in `apply`, before the table's own rows: a `HeartbeatAnswered` whose `beatId` is `finalBeatId`, or a `Tick` at or after `finalBeatAtMs + Heartbeat.TIMEOUT_MS`, returns `Step(phase.copy(finalBeatId = null), listOf(Command.Release, record("final-beat", "result" to …, "status" to …)))`; `Reset` from an `Ended` with `finalBeatId` set adds `Command.Release` before its record line. `Phase.Ended`'s new fields default to `finalBeatId: Int? = null` and `finalBeatAtMs: Long = 0`. `platformFailed` reaches `end` with `FATAL_ERROR`, so it gains the `Release` with no other edit.

In `Heartbeats.answered`, after `word` is known and before `Verdicts.beat`:

```kotlin
    val status = response?.status
    val delivered = pairing.stoppedInFlight != null && StoppedRecord.delivered(status, word)
    val codeDead = word == ServerWord.CodeEnded && pairing.stopped != null
    val deletes = if (delivered || codeDead) listOf(Command.DeleteStopped(pairing.name.code, pairing.name.slot), record("stopped-delivered", "status" to status)) else emptyList()
    // The refused set keeps the sid for the pairing's life (A17): a server that names it later is still ignored.
    val kept = if (delivered || codeDead) refreshed.copy(stopped = null) else refreshed
```

and the step it returns puts `deletes` after `noted`. A `CodeEnded` that unpairs already deletes the record in `Pairings.unpaired`; the `codeDead` deletion is for the held case, so `Pairings.unpaired` drops its own `DeleteStopped` when the record is already gone.

### Task 9: The snapshot says it all, the record stays short, and the end paths are pinned

The snapshot gains the amendment's fields, so JS never derives anything by comparing snapshots. Beat lines while paired are written only when the answer or the result changes, so a day of waiting costs a few lines. RR-12's end-path table from the earlier plan is rewritten for the paired machine: every way a broadcast and a pairing end, and what each says.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement.** `SnapshotState`:

```kotlin
  data object Pairing : SnapshotState {
    override val wire = "pairing"
  }

  data object Paired : SnapshotState {
    override val wire = "paired"
  }

  /** [retrying]: the code's last answer was no answer, so the line reads "Starting — can't reach Seazn, retrying". */
  data class Arming(val cause: Cause, val retrying: Boolean) : SnapshotState {
    override val wire = "arming"
  }

  /** [notReady]: the first check that fails (A11), or null when the gate is about to open. */
  data class Armed(val cause: Cause, val notReady: NotReady?) : SnapshotState {
    override val wire = "armed"
  }
```

The views, in `Snapshot.kt`:

```kotlin
data class PairingView(val name: PairingName, val automatic: Boolean, val waiting: WaitingFields)

data class BroadcastView(
  val sid: String,
  val cause: Cause,
  val playbackUrl: String,
  val overlayUrl: String?,
  val label: String,
  val holdWindowSeconds: Map<Transport, Int>,
  val maxDurationMinutes: Int,
  val scoreUpdates: String,
  /** A18: false when the server offered RTMPS alone; Diagnostics shows "SRT not offered". */
  val srtOffered: Boolean,
)

data class ReadyView(val camera: Boolean, val sound: Boolean, val network: Boolean, val held: Boolean)
```

The new `Snapshot` fields come last, each with a default (`null`, `false`, or an all-false `ReadyView`), so every snapshot plan B's tests build by hand compiles unchanged. `Projection.snapshot` fills them: `pairing` from `phase.pairing` (Ended included); `broadcast` from `phase.session` (or, in Arming, null); `ready` from `pairing.readiness` and `phase.networkValidated`, its `camera` being `readiness.cameraFrames && phase.camera == CameraState.OWN` (Task 7, I3) (all false with no pairing); `refusal`, `lastEnd`, `codeEndedPending` and `language` from the pairing; `unpaired` from `Phase.Idle`. `Projection.state` maps each phase to its state.

The paired beat line, in `Heartbeats.answered`: build the line's fields as before. While `phase.heldSid == null`, write it only when `fields - "message"` differs from `pairing.lastBeatLine`, and keep the new fields in `lastBeatLine`. A held beat is written every time.

```kotlin
    val record = SessionRecord { lines += it }
    // Task 5's signature: the secrets, and the stream ids a public URL may carry.
    record.protect(Configs.valid().secrets(), notInUrls = listOf(Configs.STREAM_ID))
    record.append(0, entry)
    return lines.single()
  }
```

```kotlin
  private fun scrub(key: String, value: Any?): Any? =
    when {
      key in NEVER -> MASK
      value == null || value is Boolean || value is Int || value is Long || value is Wire || value is Decimal -> value
      value is Double -> if (value.isFinite()) Decimal.tenths(value) else MASK
      value !is String -> MASK
      key in PUBLIC_URL_KEYS -> if (isPublicUrl(value)) value else MASK
      key in PLAIN_KEYS -> if (PLAIN_WORD.matches(value) && !revealed(value, secrets)) value else MASK
      key in TEXT_KEYS -> masked(value, secrets)
      else -> MASK
    }

  private fun kindWord(kind: String): String = if (PLAIN_WORD.matches(kind) && !revealed(kind, secrets)) kind else MASK

  /** https, a host, an optional port and path; no query, fragment or userinfo, and no secret but the stream id. */
  private fun isPublicUrl(value: String): Boolean = PUBLIC_URL.matches(value) && !revealed(value, urlSecrets)

  /** Whether [text] shows any of [values], raw or once decoded (the same readings `masked` uses). */
  private fun revealed(text: String, values: List<String>): Boolean {
    val decoded = percentDecoded(text)
    val readings = listOf(text, decoded, decoded.replace('+', ' '), percentDecoded(text.replace('+', ' ')))
    return values.any { secret -> readings.any { secret in it } }
  }
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Reconcile the JS side.** In `src/services/scrub.ts`:
  - `export const SCRUBBED = '***';`
  - Export `PLAIN_KEYS` with the file's list.
  - Add `PUBLIC_URL_KEYS = new Set(['url', 'playbackUrl', 'overlayUrl'])`, `TEXT_KEYS = new Set(['message', 'problems'])` and `NEVER_KEYS`.
  - Rewrite `scrubValue`. **One JS-only rule (CD6, I12, N7):** a text key is masked whole unless a session is in hand. JS holds a code's `tok` from the scan, before `useProtect` calls `logger.protect()` when the viewfinder holds the session (`useStreamArm.ts:66`), so a `message` logged in between would otherwise pass with only the shape check between it and the record. `protect` only ever adds (`logger.ts:16`), so the rule cannot be "nothing was ever protected": after the first viewfinder visit of a process that would stop holding, and a second code would be masked only by older secrets. It is keyed instead on the session in hand: `protect` sets it, and `release`, called by `useProtect`'s cleanup when the viewfinder lets the session go, clears it. Native holds nothing before an arm, so it needs no such rule, and the shared vectors (which always hold secrets, so `inHand` defaults to true) are unaffected.

```ts
function scrubValue(key: string, value: unknown, mask: Mask): LogValue {
  if (NEVER_KEYS.has(key)) return SCRUBBED;
  if (typeof value === 'number') return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : SCRUBBED;
  if (typeof value === 'boolean' || value === null) return value;
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return SCRUBBED;
  if (PUBLIC_URL_KEYS.has(key)) return isPublicUrl(value, mask) ? value : SCRUBBED;
  if (PLAIN_KEYS.has(key)) {
    return PLAIN_WORD.test(value) && !reveals(value, mask.anywhere) ? value : SCRUBBED;
  }
  if (TEXT_KEYS.has(key)) return mask.inHand ? maskedText(value, mask.anywhere) : SCRUBBED;
  return SCRUBBED;
}

/** Replaces today's `Mask` (`scrub.ts:63-64`): which values no line may show (`anywhere`), which not even a public URL (`inUrls`), and whether a session is in hand (N7). */
type Mask = {
  readonly anywhere: readonly string[];
  readonly inUrls: readonly string[];
  readonly inHand: boolean;
};

/** `inHand` defaults to "something is held", so every caller that passes no flag, and the shared vectors, keep today's answer. */
export function scrubFields(
  fields: LogFields,
  held: SessionSecrets = NOTHING_HELD,
  inHand: boolean = held.secrets.length + held.streamIds.length > 0,
): LogFields {
  // as today, with maskOf(held, inHand) building the Mask
}

/**
 * Text from a library or the platform (CD6): each known form of a secret is
 * masked where it stands, then the whole value if a decode still reveals one —
 * native's `masked`, rule for rule.
 */
function maskedText(text: string, secrets: readonly string[]): string {
  const forms = secrets
    .flatMap(formsOf)
    .filter((form) => form !== '')
    .sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);
  const replaced = forms.reduce((acc, form) => acc.split(form).join(SCRUBBED), text);
  return reveals(replaced, secrets) ? SCRUBBED : replaced;
}

/** Raw; URLEncoder's form (space as `+`); the component form `Uri.encode` writes. */
function formsOf(secret: string): readonly string[] {
  const component = encodeURIComponent(secret);
  const form = encodeURIComponent(secret)
    .replace(/%20/g, '+')
    .replace(/[!'()~]/g, (c) => `%${c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()}`);
  return [secret, form, component];
}
```

`encodeURIComponent` leaves `- _ . ! ~ * ' ( )` raw, and `Uri.encode` leaves the same set. `URLEncoder` leaves `- _ . *` raw and escapes `! ~ ' ( )`, with space as `+`, so `form` re-escapes those four. Work the `pass+phrase/6d1e8b0c` row by hand in a comment: both forms are `pass%2Bphrase%2F6d1e8b0c`.

`reveals` must read the replaced text: the `***` it inserts is not a secret, so it reveals nothing.

In `src/services/logger.ts`, `createLogger` keeps `let inHand = false`; `protect` sets it true after adding the secrets, a new `release()` sets it false, and `at` calls `scrubFields(fields, held, inHand)`. The interface gains:

```ts
  /**
   * N7: the viewfinder has let its session go. What was protected stays
   * masked; free text is masked whole until the next `protect` (CD6).
   */
  release(): void;
```

`useProtect` (`src/hooks/useStreamArm.ts:63-68`; Task 23 moves it to where the code's token is held) returns the release as its cleanup, so a session change releases the old one before the new one is protected, and leaving the viewfinder releases it:

```ts
useEffect(() => {
  if (!session?.ok) return undefined;
  logger.protect(sessionSecrets(session.value));
  return () => logger.release();
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Unify the line format (CD7).** In `src/services/sessionRecord.ts`:

```ts
/** Fields named like the line's own keys are written as `field_<key>`, as native does. */
const RESERVED = new Set(['at', 'kind', 'level']);

/**
 * One flat NDJSON line, the same shape native writes: `{at, kind, …fields}`,
 * with `level` after `kind` only when it is not `info` (CD7).
 */
export function toRecordLine({ atMs, level, event, fields }: LogEntry): string {
  const line: Record<string, unknown> = { at: new Date(atMs).toISOString(), kind: event };
  if (level !== 'info') line.level = level;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(fields))
    line[RESERVED.has(key) ? `field_${key}` : key] = value;
  return JSON.stringify(line);
}

export type RecordedEntry = {
  readonly atMs: number;
  readonly level: string;
  readonly event: string;
  readonly fields: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
};

/**
 * A line back into its parts, either side's. No `level` means `info`, which
 * neither side writes. A `field_<key>` rename is undone, so a reader sees the
 * fields as they were logged.
 */
export function parseRecordLine(line: string): RecordedEntry {
  const { at, kind, level, ...written } = JSON.parse(line) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const fields: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(written)) {
    const original = key.startsWith('field_') ? key.slice('field_'.length) : key;
    fields[RESERVED.has(original) ? original : key] = value;
  }
  return {
    atMs: Date.parse(String(at)),
    level: typeof level === 'string' ? level : 'info',
    event: String(kind),
    fields,
  };
}
```

In `test/fakePorts.ts`, keep `RecordedEntry` as `{ level, event, fields }` and change `readRecord` to `record.lines().map((line) => { const { level, event, fields } = parseRecordLine(line); return { level, event, fields }; })`, so a test comparing whole entries is unchanged. Screen tests that read `entry.event`, `entry.fields` and `entry.level` then need no change. Change each JS test listed under Files as it says there. Add to `sessionRecord.test.ts`:

### Task 11: Pair and intent mapping

Carries 1 and 10, rewritten for the paired port (amendment, _The engine port_). The bridge receives each intent as a `Map<String, Any?>`, in which Expo hands every JS number over as `Double`. The mapping must never throw. A malformed `pair` becomes a `PairRequest` whose `problems()` name what is wrong, so the machine refuses it, records the problems, and ends fatal-error and named (spec §5). `pair` needs two facts JS does not send: the install's `PhoneFacts` and this code and slot's A17 record. The mapping takes both from its caller (`BridgeCore`, Task 20), so it stays pure.

- Create: `K/adapter/PairMapping.kt`, `K/adapter/IntentMapping.kt`, `K/adapter/WireValues.kt`
- Test: `T/adapter/PairMappingTest.kt`, `T/adapter/IntentMappingTest.kt`

- Consumes `PairRequest`, `Claim`, `Environment`, `PhoneFacts`, `PairingName`, `StoppedRecord`, `Input`.
- Produces:

```kotlin
package com.seazn.capture.engine.adapter

/** Reading a bridge value that may be missing or of the wrong type. Never throws. */
object WireValues {
  /** Expo hands JS numbers over as Double. Only a whole number that fits an Int is one. */
  fun int(value: Any?): Int? =
    when (value) {
      is Int -> value
      is Long -> if (value in Int.MIN_VALUE..Int.MAX_VALUE) value.toInt() else null
      is Double -> if (value.isFinite() && value % 1.0 == 0.0 && value >= Int.MIN_VALUE && value <= Int.MAX_VALUE) value.toInt() else null
      else -> null
    }

  fun text(value: Any?): String = value as? String ?: ""

  fun flag(value: Any?): Boolean? = value as? Boolean
}
```

```kotlin
package com.seazn.capture.engine.adapter

import com.seazn.capture.engine.core.Claim
import com.seazn.capture.engine.core.Environment
import com.seazn.capture.engine.core.PairRequest

/**
 * The pair intent's wire → [PairRequest]. Lenient on purpose: a missing or mistyped field becomes a
 * blank or -1 that [PairRequest.problems] names, so a bad pair is refused, recorded and named, never
 * thrown at the bridge (spec §5).
 */
object PairMapping {
  fun request(wire: Map<String, Any?>): PairRequest =
    PairRequest(
      code = WireValues.text(wire["code"]),
      slot = WireValues.int(wire["slot"]) ?: -1,
      token = WireValues.text(wire["token"]),
      codeUrl = WireValues.text(wire["codeUrl"]),
      heartbeatUrl = WireValues.text(wire["heartbeatUrl"]),
      startUrl = WireValues.text(wire["startUrl"]),
      // (P3) The operator's language, for the notification only (CD16).
      language = WireValues.text(wire["language"]),
      automatic = WireValues.flag(wire["automatic"]) ?: true,
      claim = Claim.entries.firstOrNull { it.wire == wire["claim"] } ?: Claim.NEW,
      environment = Environment.of(wire["environment"] as? String),
    )
}
```

```kotlin
package com.seazn.capture.engine.adapter

import com.seazn.capture.engine.core.Input
import com.seazn.capture.engine.core.PairingName
import com.seazn.capture.engine.core.PhoneFacts
import com.seazn.capture.engine.core.StoppedRecord

/**
 * An intent from JS → the core's input (AGENTS §2: intents, not RPC). Null: a kind this build does
 * not know. [phone] and [stopped] are the platform's, read by `BridgeCore` (Task 20).
 */
object IntentMapping {
  fun input(wire: Map<String, Any?>, phone: PhoneFacts, stopped: (PairingName) -> StoppedRecord?): Input? =
    when (wire["kind"]) {
      "pair" -> PairMapping.request(wire).let { Input.Pair(it, phone, stopped(it.name)) }
      "start" -> Input.Start
      "stop" -> Input.Stop
      "unpair" -> Input.Unpair
      "reset" -> Input.Reset
      "setAutomatic" -> WireValues.flag(wire["on"])?.let { Input.SetAutomatic(it) }
      "setLanguage" -> Input.SetLanguage(WireValues.text(wire["language"]))
      // Carry 10: reserved. S1 has no control for it; the platform swaps to the other facing camera.
      "switchCamera" -> Input.SwitchCamera
      else -> null
    }
}
```
